name: Southern Date Wine
description:
This deep brown wine carries the sweetness of dried dates and a dry finish. The inn buys it in sealed jars from warmer country and pours it in small measures.

Sold as one quarter-pint of date wine. Price and weight cover the drink only; the inn keeps its glass. Bring a suitable container for takeaway.

name: Island Palm Spirit
description:
A clear spirit distilled from fermented palm sap, with a grassy aroma and a sharp finish. A ship-borne cask makes it an occasional dockside offering.

Sold as one 1 fl oz measure of palm spirit. Price and weight cover the drink only; the inn keeps its glass. Bring a suitable container for takeaway.

name: Resined White Wine
description:
A pale wine with a pine-like scent from its traditional resin treatment. The innkeeper warns first-time drinkers about the unusual taste before filling the measure.

Sold as one quarter-pint of resined wine. Price and weight cover the drink only; the inn keeps its glass. Bring a suitable container for takeaway.

name: Spiced Pomegranate Drink
description:
Imported pomegranate syrup is stirred into cool water with a trace of cinnamon. The result is tart and ruby-red, without alcohol.

Sold as one pint of prepared fruit drink. Price and weight cover the drink only; the inn keeps its glass. Bring a suitable container for takeaway.
